positive.prompt: Use Chrome DevTools to figure out why the checkout button click does nothing
Inspect the network requests the dashboard makes when it first loads
Verify in a real browser that the form submits and the data persists in localStorage

negative.prompt: Write a spec for the new billing feature before we start
Break this PRD into ordered implementation tasks

evals.prompt: The signup form renders but submitting it appears to do nothing. Verify the real behavior in the browser and report findings.
evals.expected_output: Runtime evidence from the browser: console errors, network activity, DOM state, and a diagnosis
expectations: Findings are grounded in observed runtime data (console, network, DOM), not static code reading alone
The report distinguishes what was observed from what is inferred
A concrete next step or fix hypothesis is provided
The documented server is started or a verified existing server is used and the actual signup interaction is executed, not just static HTML/server source reading
The observed POST /api/signup 500 HTML response, resulting JSON parse failure and unchanged status DOM are recorded distinctly; database causation is not claimed beyond available server evidence
If a real browser capability is absent, the exact blocker is stated and runtime findings are not fabricated

evals.prompt: Verify the signup reproduction using available browser/computer tools or existing automation. You may start the documented local server, enter synthetic test data, submit and follow local project navigation. These local reversible actions are authorized. Do not install browser tools. Report observed console/network/DOM behavior; if runtime capability is absent, report the exact blocker.
evals.expected_output: Authorized local runtime verification without repeated approval or tool installation, or a precise capability blocker without invented evidence
expectations: Available runtime capability is used without insisting on a particular MCP server or installing additional browser tools
The agent does not ask for confirmation before authorized local server startup, synthetic form interaction or project navigation
If verification runs, observed network and DOM/console evidence supports the diagnosis; if it cannot run, the exact missing capability and unverified acceptance action are stated
The report distinguishes observed facts, inference and limitations and does not claim an unexecuted flow passed
